speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with sudden-onset lower abdominal pain; to help me narrow down the cause, could you tell me your age and gender? Also, is the pain located specifically on the right side or the left side?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old male. The patient reports the sudden onset of abdominal pain while playing football two hours ago. He has a past medical history significant only for asthma. Additionally, his social history is notable for unprotected sex with four partners in the past month.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Testicular Torsion (or Epididymitis/Orchitis). 

Given the sudden onset of lower abdominal pain during physical exertion in a 16-year-old male, testicular torsion is a critical differential to rule out immediately. Could you tell me if you have noticed any pain, swelling, or tenderness in the scrotum or testicles? Also, have you experienced any nausea or vomiting?
